title.en: On the board: Memory units and the memory hierarchy

say.en: The smallest unit is a bit, 0 or 1. Four bits make a nibble and eight bits make a byte.
After the byte, every unit is 1024 times the one before it, because 1024 is 2 to the power 10.
So 2 GB is 2 times 1024 cubed bytes, more than two billion bytes.
Memory is arranged as a hierarchy. At the top, registers inside the CPU are the fastest but tiny; at the bottom, secondary storage is huge but slow.
Going up, memory gets faster and costlier per byte. Going down, it gets bigger and cheaper.
RAM loses its contents when power goes off: it is volatile. ROM and secondary storage keep their data: they are non-volatile.

text.en: Cache sits between CPU and RAM

narration.en: We climb the ladder of memory units and then compare registers, cache, RAM and secondary storage.

body.en: Primary memory is directly accessed by the CPU. RAM (Random Access Memory) holds the programs and data in use; it is volatile, so its contents are lost when power goes off. ROM (Read Only Memory) is non-volatile and stores start-up instructions. Cache memory is a small, very fast memory between the CPU and RAM that keeps frequently used data. Secondary memory, such as a hard disk, SSD, pen drive or DVD, is non-volatile and stores data permanently, but it is slower and cannot be accessed directly by the CPU.

points.en: Speed: registers > cache > RAM > secondary storage
Capacity and cost per byte go the other way
RAM is volatile; ROM and secondary memory are non-volatile

narration.en: Primary memory is directly accessed by the CPU. RAM (Random Access Memory) holds the programs and data in use; it is volatile, so its contents are lost when power goes off. ROM (Read Only Memory) is non-volatile and stores start-up instructions. Cache memory is a small, very fast memory between the CPU and RAM that keeps frequently used data. Secondary memory, such as a hard disk, SSD, pen drive or DVD, is non-volatile and stores data permanently, but it is slower and cannot be accessed directly by the CPU.
narration.kn: ಪ್ರಾಥಮಿಕ ಸ್ಮರಣೆಯನ್ನು CPU ನೇರವಾಗಿ ಬಳಸುತ್ತದೆ. RAM ಅಸ್ಥಿರ (volatile) — ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಹೋದರೆ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಅಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. ROM ಸ್ಥಿರ ಸ್ಮರಣೆ. ಕ್ಯಾಶ್ ಸ್ಮರಣೆ CPU ಮತ್ತು RAM ನಡುವೆ ಇರುವ ಅತಿ ವೇಗದ ಸ್ಮರಣೆ. ಹಾರ್ಡ್ ಡಿಸ್ಕ್, SSD, ಪೆನ್ ಡ್ರೈವ್ ದ್ವಿತೀಯ ಸ್ಮರಣೆಗಳು — ಶಾಶ್ವತ ಆದರೆ ನಿಧಾನ.
